text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...One, two, one...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Your gaze dropped again, didn't it...
choice_data_list: Let's try to be more conscious of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, I pretend to wave a penlight and step over to where the audience would be.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My... hehe. What an enthusiastic customer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—...Phew.
It went well this time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Less like the crowd as a whole, and more like one specific person...
I feel like our eyes have been locked the entire time..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Next time, try to take in the whole audience.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, I'm... I'm so sorry...!
I was looking only at you, Trainer...
I-I'll be more careful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps out of embarrassment, Still in Love turned her back to me and placed a hand on her cheek as if to cool her fever. Then, exhaling a breath—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
I have... a question...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, it's not really a big worry or anything.
It's just, um... about my dancing...
choice_data_list: You did a really great job.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so happy. Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"However... what I was thinking about just now
wasn't that, but..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...A-Am I... properly being noticed
by everyone... when I'm on stage...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... I tend to blend into the background, so to speak... so people rarely seem to notice me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It is true that she sometimes completely masks
her presence from those around her.
Subconsciously, no less. But—"
choice_data_list: No one will be able to take their eyes off the center
When that time comes, I'll call your name from the crowd.
When that time comes, I'll call out your name from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It is true that she sometimes completely masks
her presence from those around her.
Subconsciously, no less. But—"
choice_data_list: No one will be able to take their eyes off the center
When that time comes, I'll call your name from the crowd.
When that time comes, I'll call out your name from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! That is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...You believe that I...
can stand in the center, don't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy.
You always watch over me
without the slightest doubt..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
I want to be someone... worthy of you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I stand on stage......
I'm sure I'll always remember today.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Holding these warm feelings in my heart...
I shall convey my gratitude to everyone as well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"With your voice...
perhaps everyone else will notice as well..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel encouraged.
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter what stage I stand upon...
I will stay true to myself and dance with all my might...
to deliver my gratitude to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Within Still in Love's calm eyes, unchanging as ever, I felt an unshakeable strength.
